inputs.text: A realistic cute amateur portrait photograph of a young Romanian woman standing in a cozy modern bedroom, looking directly at the camera with a warm, adorable smile while raising one hand in a friendly open-palm wave as if saying hello. She has curly pastel pink hair, stylish round glasses, soft rosy cheeks, and a fluffy white bunny ear headband with pink inner ears. She wears a clean white t-shirt with cute pink retro graffiti-style lettering that reads "PIXA" across the front. The bedroom is simple and authentic, featuring a neatly made bed, soft blankets, a bedside lamp, a small houseplant, light wood furniture, and minimal modern decor. The composition is a vertical waist-up portrait at eye level with a natural candid feel, gentle background blur, and the look of a casually taken smartphone photo. Soft window daylight blended with warm indoor lighting creates flattering natural illumination. The color palette is white, blush pink, cream, warm beige, and pastel pink. Realistic skin texture, soft curly hair, natural cotton fabric, and subtle smartphone camera grain create a genuine, wholesome, cheerful lifestyle photograph.
